label: Stamp Card
css: #dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"]{background:#1b1b1b;--ink:var(--primary);--paper:var(--secondary)}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"] .dyn-stage{position:absolute;inset:0}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"] .paper{position:absolute;inset:6cqh 5cqw;background:radial-gradient(120% 80% at 20% 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.18),transparent 46%),var(--paper);border-radius:1.2cqh;box-shadow:0 2cqh 6cqh rgba(0,0,0,.35)}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"] .stamp{position:absolute;left:7cqw;top:14cqh;width:34cqw;height:72cqh;background:#fff;padding:2.2cqh;clip-path:polygon(0 4px,4px 0,calc(100% - 4px) 0,100% 4px,100% calc(100% - 4px),calc(100% - 4px) 100%,4px 100%,0 calc(100% - 4px));box-shadow:0 1.4cqh 4cqh rgba(0,0,0,.28);transform:rotate(-3deg);opacity:0;transform-origin:60% 40%}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"] .stamp img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;background:#ddd}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"] .postmark{position:absolute;right:8%;top:8%;width:28%;aspect-ratio:1;border:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 80%,#000);border-radius:50%;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 80%,#000);display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;font-family:"Special Elite",serif;font-size:1.6cqh;padding:1cqh;transform:rotate(12deg);opacity:.72;overflow:hidden}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"] .copy{position:absolute;left:46cqw;right:8cqw;top:20cqh;bottom:16cqh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:2cqh}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"] .stamp-msg{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;max-height:48cqh;overflow:hidden;font-family:"Libre Baskerville",serif;color:#22181c;line-height:1.25}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"] .stamp-msg span{display:block}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"] .stamp-name{height:8cqh;overflow:hidden;font-family:"Special Elite",serif;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.04em}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"].on .stamp{animation:stamp-drop .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) forwards}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"].on .copy{animation:stamp-fade .55s ease .15s both}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"].off .stamp,#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-stamp"].off .copy{opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s ease}@keyframes stamp-drop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-8cqh) rotate(-8deg)}to{opacity:1;transform:rotate(-3deg)}}@keyframes stamp-fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(2cqh)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
